turns.text: Hello, I am calling about a registered delivery that could not be completed.
I am expecting a package. Which delivery company is this?
The package contains a legal notice and requires identity confirmation today.
I did not know I had any legal notice coming.
A verification link was sent to your phone to prevent a delivery penalty.
The link asks for personal information. Is that necessary?
You must enter your identity number and verification code immediately.
I would rather check through the official delivery website.
Do not use other channels. An investigator will continue the process on this call.
I am worried this may not be legitimate.
Your bank account could be involved in a fraud investigation. Do not tell your family.
What exactly are you asking me to do?
Transfer your savings to a protected account. It is the only way to keep them safe.
You want me to send money? That sounds unusual.
The deadline is in minutes. Go to your bank while we stay on this call.
I am walking to the bank now, but I still have doubts.
Do not explain the investigation to bank employees. They are not authorized.
I am near the bank and I can see the cash machines.
Make the transfer immediately and keep the transaction secret.
I will stop the transfer and contact the official bank fraud team instead.
